My name is Ian O'Keeffe. After years of working in webdev, I'm currently studying Biostatistics at Columbia's Mailman School of Public Health with a goal of helping make the world a better place.

In my spare time, I sometimes run, perform improv, sit on the board of the Duke Comedy Theater, a 501(c)(3) organization based in Beacon New York. I love games, whether board or video, and love traveling to explore new cultures.
